captions.detailed: This 3D model consists of a simple, flat rectangular base plate. It has a uniform thickness and straight edges, forming a elongated rectangular strip. In the provided renders, the plate is shown as a plain solid without any visible extruded text or logos on its top surface.
captions.instruction: Create a parametric label generator in OpenSCAD. The design should feature a rectangular base plate with adjustable length, width, and thickness. It must support customizable text lines with selectable fonts, adjustable letter height, thickness, and positioning, as well as an optional scaleable logo using a polyhedron.
captions.factory: The script uses a `cube` primitive to generate the rectangular base plate (`maincolor` module) with parameters `_length`, `_width`, and `_height`. It imports an external library `Write.scad` to write customizable text onto the plate surface via the `write()` function, translating it in three dimensions using parameters `x`, `y`, `letter_thick`, and `_height`. An optional custom logo is generated using a `polyhedron` module (`object1`) and positioned using `translate` and `scale` transforms.
